rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"The TypeCollector now wraps its analyzer report callback so a diagnostic is reported only when its location is a source location in a syntax tree of the compilation being analysed. Diagnostics with no location, or a location from metadata or another compilation, are dropped. Two diagnostic sites that read DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] now use FirstOrDefault, so they no longer index into an empty list for members loaded from metadata. Three generator tests compile a defining assembly to a metadata-only reference and check that the build has no diagnostics and that the resolver is generated.
